name: Clock Push-Up
steps: Set up in a high plank with hands beneath your shoulders and body straight from head to heels.
Walk or place one hand diagonally forward while keeping that arm straight.
Bend the opposite elbow to lower your chest toward the floor with your hips level.
Press back to the plank, return the reaching hand under your shoulder, and alternate sides.
tips: Keep your hips square and core braced as you reach.
Avoid flaring your bending elbow wide or letting your lower back sag.
